title: Head of AI Governance
description:
Head of AI Governance

London | £150,000 - £170,000 + Benefits

This is a rare opportunity to shape and lead AI governance for a globally recognised organisation undergoing significant AI transformation. You will define how artificial intelligence is adopted responsibly at scale, influencing strategy, policy, risk, and assurance across a complex international environment.

The Company

They are a global professional services organisation with a strong focus on innovation, technology, and responsible AI adoption. Operating across multiple international markets, they are investing heavily in AI capabilities to drive business value while maintaining robust governance, security, and compliance standards.

With senior leadership support and a clear AI vision, they are building a best-in-class governance function that will play a critical role in enabling safe, effective, and scalable AI adoption across the organisation.

The Role

You will lead the development and execution of the organisation's AI governance framework, ensuring responsible and compliant use of AI technologies across global operations.

Responsibilities include:

  • Designing and scaling enterprise-wide AI governance frameworks covering generative AI, agentic AI, traditional AI, and third-party AI solutions.
  • Developing AI policies, standards, controls, and governance processes aligned with organisational objectives.
  • Establishing governance forums, councils, and working groups to support effective decision-making and oversight.
  • Creating and maintaining AI risk taxonomies, control libraries, risk registers, and assurance frameworks.
  • Leading AI use case governance from assessment and approval through to monitoring and retirement.
  • Implementing governance controls relating to transparency, accountability, explainability, security, and human oversight.
  • Overseeing governance for agentic AI systems, including permissions, autonomy boundaries, auditability, and risk controls.
  • Managing governance and assurance processes for third-party AI vendors and external AI platforms.
  • Ensuring alignment with global AI regulations and standards, including the EU AI Act, NIST frameworks, ISO/IEC 42001, and other international requirements.
  • Delivering governance reporting, maturity assessments, leadership updates, and AI training programmes across the organisation.
  • Building and leading a high-performing AI governance team while acting as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders.

Your Skills & Experience

  • Strong commercial experience designing and implementing AI, data, or technology governance frameworks within complex organisations.
  • Deep expertise across AI governance, including policy development, controls, assurance, risk management, and responsible AI principles.
  • Knowledge of AI regulatory and compliance requirements, including frameworks such as the EU AI Act, NIST, and ISO/IEC 42001.
  • Experience establishing governance operating models, steering committees, working groups, or oversight forums.
  • Ability to engage and influence senior stakeholders across technology, legal, compliance, risk, security, and business functions.
  • Experience developing governance processes for AI platforms, generative AI, agentic AI, and third-party AI technologies.
  • Strong leadership capability with experience building teams and driving organisational change.
  • Background within professional services, legal services, financial services, or other regulated environments would be advantageous.

What They Offer

  • Opportunity to shape AI governance strategy for a large international organisation.
  • High visibility and engagement with executive stakeholders.
  • Significant career progression opportunities within a growing data and AI function.
  • Ongoing investment in professional development and leadership growth.

How to Apply

Apply now to discuss this opportunity and learn more about how you can influence responsible AI adoption at global scale.
